reasoning: Using into to mean not surjective: I is into because its nonnegative outputs omit −1 from its codomain R. II is surjective onto [0,∞), since every y≥0 has the real preimage x=√y. III is into because e^x>0 for every real x, so 0 in its codomain has no preimage. Hence I and III only are into functions, agreeing with Math Academy's worked solution.

answers.ma_evidence: Therefore, the correct answer is "I and III only."
